name: Lickilicky
description: Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky's height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user restores its own HP but also becomes drowsy.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user tramples its target into the ground, dealing damage. This also lowers the target’s action speed.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.description: The user rolls into the target to deal damage, then becomes fixated on using this move.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power.
